description: Preferred default Nemotron text profile for one Spark, serving the exact Nemotron 3.5 Lightning NVFP4 checkpoint without a speculative companion. NVIDIA's Marlin MoE and aligned Mamba cache settings preserve deployment headroom relative to the specialized high-context latency profile; physical GB10 acceptance is still required. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B NVFP4 vLLM single Spark (preferred)
